rows.note: Use this for a small broken piece or fragment of something.

example.english: I picked up a tiny glass particle from the floor.
example.traditional: 我喺地下執到一塊好細嘅玻璃碎片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 dei6 haa6 zap1 dou2 jat1 faai3 hou2 sai3 ge3 bo1 lei4 seoi3 pin2

rows.note: For the small-amount sense, this is the all-purpose everyday choice.

example.english: I don't have a particle of patience left; I don't want to wait any longer.
example.traditional: 我一啲耐性都冇，唔想再等喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 di1 noi6 sing3 dou1 mou5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 dang2 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a physical or subatomic particle in science.

example.english: Scientists are studying this new particle.
example.traditional: 科學家研究緊呢種新嘅粒子。
example.jyutping: fo1 hok6 gaa1 jin4 gau3 gan2 ne1 zung2 san1 ge3 lap1 zi2
